name: 13 — Multiple tool calls in a single iteration fan out and resolve
description: The orchestrator routes every tool_call in a parsed LLM response through dispatchToolCalls sequentially (one toolDispatcher invocation, internal sequencing). This scenario asks the agent to call get_time three times with different timezones in a single iteration. Verifies the orchestrator emits one tool_calls event listing all three tools, then one tool_result event per call, and then proceeds to iteration_complete. The get_time tool is purely local — no external HTTP — so the run stays hermetic. Final session is completed with no errors.
